# Moodle Teacher Test Coverage Report

**Ground Truth:** `MoodleTeacher.md` (220 test cases across 15 modules)

**Generated by:** openai/gpt-5-mini | **Approach:** Agent | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

### Generated Tests Strengths
The Agent approach successfully generated an incredibly robust and comprehensive test suite containing **295 tests**, achieving near-perfect mapping of the Moodle Teacher ground truth. The agent's ability to interact with the DOM allows it to inherently discover complex Moodle structures (e.g., Course Edit Mode drag-and-drop, Activity Choosers, Block management) that heavily confuse Zero-Shot approaches.

Furthermore, the agent heavily over-indexes on **interaction edge cases** — systematically verifying rapid double-clicks, browser back navigations, idempotency, and explicit security boundaries across every single module. Its only minor weaknesses are in highly nuanced visual fallbacks (broken images) and exact decimal/byte threshold boundaries, which are difficult to assert via standard DOM traversal alone.
